points.description: States that passing by reference avoids copying the argument/data when the function is called (no copy of the data is made; the function works on the original via a reference/address).
points.partial_credit: Award 1.5 if the student only says it passes the address/reference or allows the function to modify the original, without stating that copying is avoided.

points.description: Links the benefit to large data structures (e.g. big arrays, objects, structs), i.e. the saving matters when the data is large.
points.partial_credit: Award 1 if the student mentions efficiency (less memory/time) in general terms without referring to large data or the cost of copying.
